component: Notification physical shortcut and localized instruction

quotes.text:
# This is the label of the key typically used to generate the javascript
# key code "KeyJ"
-in-app-notification-accesskey = j

in-app-notification-instructions = {
  PLATFORM() ->
  [macos] Press ⌥+Shift+{ -in-app-notification-accesskey } to jump to notification
  *[other] Press Alt+Shift+{ -in-app-notification-accesskey } to jump to notification
}

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The notification handler checks code KeyJ with Alt and Shift, rather than the produced key character. Fluent uses a term for the key's label and PLATFORM() for the Option/Alt instruction. The instruction span is visually clipped rather than display:none. Preserve the physical-key contract and the displayed/spoken instructions as two linked pieces; localization of the term does not change the handler's code. No layout, conflict or assistive-technology test was run.
title: Keep localized shortcut instructions aligned with the physical key code
